newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's RWE-DEA expects no rise in petrol prices.
newsitem.headline: Germany's RWE-DEA expects no rise in petrol prices.

text.p: German oil company RWE-DEA, the petroleum and chemical subsidiary of diversified utility group RWE AG said on Tuesday it did not expect an increase in petroleum prices in Germany soon.
RWE-DEA chief executive Peter Koch told journalists that there could be an increase in the price of light heating oil, given a projected increase in demand in coming weeks.
Koch was speaking to journalists at the RWE unit's annual news conference, at which he also confirmed that RWE-DEA had contributed sales of 24.3 billion marks to overall group sales.
